'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Al-Shati refugee camp airstrike]]
****Israel launches [[airstrike]]s on the [[Al-Shati camp|Al-Shati]] [[refugee camp]] in the Gaza Strip, resulting in [[civilian]] casualties. [https://edition.cnn.com/videos/world/2023/10/09/gaza-al-shati-refugee-camp-israel-airstrike-cnc-vpx.cnn (CNN)]
***[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
****Pro-[[State of Palestine|Palestine]] and pro-[[Israel]] [[Israel–Hamas war protests|protests]] are held in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], with pro-Palestinian protesters also gathering at the [[Embassy of Israel, London|Israeli Embassy]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/world/uk-news/2023/10/09/londoners-rally-in-support-of-israel-and-palestine-revealing-deep-divisions/ (''The National News'')] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/pro-palestine-protesters-gather-in-front-of-israeli-embassy-in-london/3013519 (AA)]

***[[Jabalia camp market airstrike]]
****Israel launches airstrikes on a market in the [[Jabalia Camp]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], killing more than 60 civilians and injuring 120 others. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/10/09/world/middleeast/israel-gaza-market-air-strike-jabaliya.html (''The New York Times'')]
***[[2023 Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]]
****Israel announces a total [[blockade]] of the Gaza Strip, encompassing supplies of food, water, electricity, and gas. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/10/9/israel-announces-total-blockade-on-gaza (Al Jazeera)]

[https://english.news.cn/20231010/b0d921577b114eaa8049b61ed89b24ed/c.html (Xinhua)]
***At least 22 members of a Palestinian family, including seven children, are killed in an Israeli air strike in [[Khan Younis]], [[Gaza Strip]]. Six members of the family remain trapped under the rubble of the destroyed house. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/8/israel-palestine-escalation-live-israeli-forces-bombard-gaza (Al Jazeera)]

[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/9/israel-hamas-war-live-news-israel-orders-complete-siege-of-gaza-strip (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israeli-death-toll-in-gaza-war-said-to-climb-to-800/ (''Times of Israel'')]

Earlier, one Palestinian was killed by Israeli forces in [[Hebron]], [[West Bank]], one in [[Jericho]], and two in [[Ramallah]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/8/israel-palestine-escalation-live-israeli-forces-bombard-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
***In [[Duma, Nablus]], a Palestinian is shot by Israeli soldiers, while [[Israeli settlement|Israeli settlers]] [[arson|torch cars]] and attack farmers. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/9/israel-hamas-war-live-news-israel-orders-complete-siege-of-gaza-strip (Al Jazeera)]
***In [[Einabus]], [[West Bank]], two Palestinians are shot by Israeli soldiers. Twelve people are evacuated for [[tear gas]] inhalation, with Israeli forces attempting to stop the evacuation by [[emergency services]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/9/israel-hamas-war-live-news-israel-orders-complete-siege-of-gaza-strip (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haitian crisis]]
**A court in [[Kenya]] temporarily blocks the [[Government of Kenya|government]] from deploying [[Kenya Police|police personnel]] to [[Haiti]] until 24 October. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/oct/09/court-blocks-kenya-from-deploying-police-officers-to-haiti (''The Guardian'')]
*A car crashes into the [[China|Chinese]] [[consulate]] in [[San Francisco]], [[California]], [[United States]], and its driver is shot dead by [[San Francisco Police Department|police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/san-francisco-police-fatally-shoot-driver-car-that-crashed-into-chinese-2023-10-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[National Police of Peru|Peruvian police]] liberate 44 individuals, mostly [[Malaysians]], from a [[Taiwan]]ese [[Transnational organized crime|organized crime]] group's [[extortion]] scheme in [[La Molina District|La Molina]], [[Lima Province|Lima]]. Concurrently, six [[Taiwanese people|Taiwanese]] and two [[Peruvians]] are arrested, and the victims, who were [[Employment fraud|deceived with job offers]] and [[Human trafficking|trafficked]] via [[Amsterdam]], [[Netherlands]], will be [[extradited]] to [[Malaysia]] following an investigative process. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/peruvian-police-rescue-malaysians-taiwanese-held-by-taiwanese-gang (AFP via ''The Straits Times'')]
